about: Demo seed coordinates, one list per seed area (scripts/seed-data.ts). Northeast Georgia areas: every point was checked to be on land against USGS National Hydrography Dataset waterbodies and to fall inside the listed Georgia county (USGS National Map boundaries). core: near downtown; town: inside city limits; rural: 1-7 km outside town; waterfront: 25-100 m from the lake shore (mainland); near: 250 m-2.5 km from the lake. Row format: [lat, lng, county] or, for lakes, [lat, lng, county, city, zip]. Statewide areas: generated by scripts/dev/gen-seed-sites.ts from Census TIGERweb (places, counties, 2020 ZCTAs, roads, military, prison, college and park land), USGS NHD water and marsh, and USGS GNIS centers. core: inside city limits within 1.2 km of the center; town: inside city limits (Virginia-Highland: the City of Atlanta neighborhood) within 8 km; rural: outside every incorporated place, 1-7 km from the city limits (consolidated city-counties: their own fringe, 8-14.5 km out). Every point is on land, near a street, 150 m from any other, and its ZIP (the ZCTA at the point) has the row's city as its mailing city. Row format: [lat, lng, county, city, zip]. Run `npx tsx scripts/dev/gen-seed-sites.ts --check` to re-verify every row.
